message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Sample workflow for building and deploying a Jekyll site to GitHub Pages
name: Deploy doc to GitHub Pages

on:
  # Runs on pushes targeting the default branch
  push:
    branches: ["master"]

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.
# However, do NOT cancel in-progress runs as we want to allow these production deployments to complete.
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Build job
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6.0.0
      - name: Generate HTML from Markdown
        uses: ldeluigi/markdown-docs@latest
        with:
          src: doc
          dst: generated
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5.0.0
        with:
          path: generated
          
  # Deployment job
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5.0.1
",
  "rationale": "Added a 10-minute timeout to both the build and deploy jobs to bound runaway execution. The workflow currently has no timeout, so a hung step could consume the default 6-hour limit. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern reports up to 12.9% free and 8.1% paid VM time reduction by preventing runaway jobs, and the experiment example shows a 26.8% elapsed time reduction when a 5-minute timeout was applied. A 10-minute limit provides ample headroom for the simple markdown generation and deployment steps while protecting against stuck runs.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
